summary: A multisite contract changes what it requires of a worker according to the law in {state}.
realLife: The GM agreement made its union-membership provisions inoperative in states that forbade conditioning employment on membership. The Indiana plants became the focus of a different proposal.
gates: The case record identifies the contract exception, plant location and state law at the time.
inGame: needs: contract exception, plant location and state law at the time.

turns.what: The local needs a proposal consistent with that state's law.
The parties check the ordinary clause and effective date.
